description_en: Modifies the configuration of an HTTP listener
name: SetLoadBalancerHTTPListenerAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en: The listener port whose attributes you want to modify. Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改属性的监听端口。取值：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The listener name. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length.

The name cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
设置监听名称。长度限制为1~80个字符。

不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:
wrr: Backend servers with higher weights are polled more frequently.
wlc: Requests are distributed based on the weight and actual load (number of connections) of each backend server. When the weights are the same, backend servers with fewer connections are polled more frequently.
rr: Requests are distributed to backend servers in sequence.
sch: Consistent hashing based on source IP addresses. Requests from the same source IP address are distributed to the same backend server.
qch: Consistent hashing based on QUIC Connection IDs. Requests with the same QUIC Connection ID are distributed to the same backend server.
iqch: Consistent hashing based on specific three bytes of the iQUIC CID. Requests with the same 2nd to 4th bytes are distributed to the same backend server
parameters.help_zh:
调度算法。取值：
wrr：权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的次数（概率）也越高。
wlc：除了根据每台后端服务器设定的权重值来进行轮询，同时还考虑后端服务器的实际负载（即连接数）。当权重值相同时，当前连接数越小的后端服务器被轮询到的次数（概率）也越高。
rr：按照访问顺序依次将外部请求依序分发到后端服务器。
sch：基于源IP地址的一致性Hash，相同的源地址会调度到相同的后端服务器。
qch：基于QUIC Connection ID一致性Hash，相同的QUIC Connection ID会调度到相同的后端服务器。
iqch：针对iQUIC CID的特定三个字节进行一致Hash，第2~第4三个字节相同的会调度到相同的后端服务器
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable health checks. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: health_check

parameters.help_en:
The domain name used for health checks.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的域名。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_domain

parameters.help_en:
The URI used for health checks. The URI must be 1 to 80 characters in length.

The URI cannot be only `/` but must start with `/`.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的URI。长度限制为1~80。

URL不能只有`/`，但必须以`/`开头。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_uri

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks required before a backend server is declared healthy (changing the status from fail to success). Valid values: 2 to 10.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由fail（后台服务器不可达）判定为success（后台服务器可达）。取值：2~10。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: healthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks required before a backend server is declared unhealthy (changing the status from success to fail). Valid values: 2 to 10.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由success（后台服务器可达）判定为fail（后台服务器不可达）。取值：2~10。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: unhealthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The amount of time to wait for a response from a health check. If the backend ECS instance does not respond within the specified time, the health check fails.
Default value: 5 seconds.
Valid values: 1 to 300.
Unit: seconds.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on.
If the value of HealthCheckTimeout is less than the value of HealthCheckInterval, HealthCheckTimeout becomes ineffective and the timeout period equals the value of HealthCheckInterval
parameters.help_zh:
接收来自运行状况检查的响应需要等待的时间。如果后端ECS在指定的时间内没有响应，则判定为健康检查失败。
默认值：5秒。
取值：1~300。
单位：秒。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效。
如果HealthCHeckTimeout的值小于HealthCheckInterval的值，则HealthCHeckTimeout无效，超时时间为HealthCheckInterval的值
parameters.name: health_check_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The port used for health checks. Valid values: 1 to 65535. If this parameter is not configured in Settings, the backend service port (BackendServerPort) is used.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查使用的端口，取值：1~65535。不设置此参数时，表示使用后端服务端口（BackendServerPort）。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_connect_port

parameters.help_en:
The interval between two consecutive health checks. Valid values: 1 to 50. Unit: seconds.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。取值：1~50，单位：秒。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_interval

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP status code that indicates a successful health check. Valid values:

http_2xx (default).
http_3xx.
http_4xx.
http_5xx.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查正常时的HTTP状态码。取值：

http_2xx（默认值）。
http_3xx。
http_4xx。
http_5xx。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_http_code

parameters.help_en:
The idle connection timeout period. Default value: 15 seconds. Valid values: 1 to 60. Unit: seconds.

If no access request is received within the timeout period, the load balancing instance temporarily breaks the current connection and re-establishes a new connection when the next request arrives
parameters.help_zh:
指定连接空闲超时时间，默认值：15秒，取值：1~60，单位：秒。

在超时时间内一直没有访问请求，负载均衡会暂时中断当前连接，直到一下次请求来临时重新建立新的连接
parameters.name: idle_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The request timeout period. Default value: 60 seconds. Valid values: 1 to 180. Unit: seconds.

If no response is received from the backend server within the timeout period, the load balancing instance stops waiting and returns an HTTP 504 error code to the client
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求超时时间，默认值：60秒，取值：1~180，单位：秒。

在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，负载均衡将放弃等待，给客户端返回HTTP的504错误码
parameters.name: request_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The health check method for the HTTP listener. Valid values:

head.
get.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
监听HTTP类型健康检查的健康检查方法。取值：

head。
get。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_method

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the X-Forwarded-For header to retrieve the originating IP address of the client. Valid values:
on (default): enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启通过X-Forwarded-For字段获取来访者真实IP。取值：
on（默认值）：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: xforwarded_for
